Directly extracts person data from Excel files and generates comprehensive BMI analysis with medical-grade precision. Employs iterative enhancement technology that progressively improves result accuracy and depth with each interaction. Features multi-dimensional health assessment including risk factors, personalized recommendations, and comparative analysis.
